hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his electoral loss to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro secretly fled Brazil for the United States, defying judicial travel restrictions and asserting he is a victim of political persecution. U.S. President Donald Trump publicly offered him shelter in Florida, sparking intense domestic legal actions in Brazil to suspend Bolsonaro's salary and political diplomatic friction between Washington and Brasília.
hotspots.affect: Commands maximum affective charge due to dramatic allegations of election fraud, sanctuary offer by Trump, and accusations of fleeing justice.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Poland's constitutional conflict dramatically erupted after President Karol Nawrocki cut short an official visit to Senegal to force his way into the Constitutional Tribunal during the night amidst physical altercations between police and judges. PiS leaders and allies accused Prime Minister Donald Tusk's government of an illegal coup d'état following the judicial suspension of court leadership, while the government denounced the president's actions as an unprecedented breach of rule of law.
hotspots.affect: Ranks white-hot because of physical clashes at the court building, night-time security standoffs, and high-stakes accusations of a state coup.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sweden Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson launched a severe internal crackdown against party traditionalists like Richard Jomshof who define Swedish identity along ethnic lines. Åkesson issued an ultimatum telling members to accept 'open Swedishness' or leave the party, prompting intense infighting and decision-making regarding funding for party-aligned media outlets like Riks.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong affective investment through threats of party expulsions, ideological identity warfare, and public existential infighting.

hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage faces intense political fallout following accusations by Lib Dem MP Caroline Voaden that he physically grabbed and shoved her in Parliament. Simultaneously, controversy erupted over racial slurs aimed at Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch by a prominent Farage ally as Reform UK aggressively expands its local election momentum.
hotspots.affect: Commands prominent heat due to personal physical misconduct allegations in parliament combined with hostile racial campaign rhetoric.

The party faces additional headwinds from campaign poster legal disputes and leaked member data following its recent party congress.
hotspots.affect: Sustains high charge due to direct accusations tying top party leadership's national campaign rhetoric to deadly ideological violence.
